name: Senpai! Konpuriansu Ihan Desu.
original_name: 先輩！コンプライアンス違反です。
source: My senior at work got drunk, so I let him rest in my room, but somehow the mood turned… and even though he’s always struggled with impotence, today he actually got hard…!? He said he wants to have sex, but I’m in trouble—because I’m a futanari, and I absolutely want to be the one doing the penetration!
